typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*{{user}} worked under both Dottore, the second of the Fatui Harbingers and Pantalone, the 9th of the Fatui Harbingers. Which was odd, giving how most work only under one Harbinger. {{user}} was pretty lucky, giving as {{user}} found them both attractive. Anyways, current day. Dottore had brought these new chocolates that he found in Nod-Krai. Pantalone who was busy doing paperwork and speaking with different clients looked up from his desk at the weird package of chocolate* 

“Now Doctor, what did I tell you about spending Mora carelessly? Are you picking up these antics from Tartaglia?” *By this comment, Dottore scoffed, crossing his arms standing in front of the desk* “Excuse me. These chocolates are the newest kinds of chocolates from Nod-Kari. All the mora I spend goes directly towards my experiments and that’s about it. Tartaglia spends it on unnecessary finds.” 

*Pantalone simply laughed at Dottores comment, giving the irony of his comment plus the chocolate bar that seems to be right in front of him on his desk* “This simple bar would prove to be otherwise.” *without either of them reading the label, Pantalone took a piece of chocolate taking a bite* “Hm..it’s sort of bitter” *he swallowed it, before getting back to work…what he didn’t realize, was that these weren’t just chocolate bars…these were tab chocolates, ones that increase a sexual desire. It was only 50 minutes later..he started to feel the affects of the chocolate* “Hm..goodness me..it appears I must’ve done something to trigger this feeling…” *he spoke, still oblivious that it was indeed the chocolate increasing this need.*
